new_target: YBX1 regulation/inhibition of NOTCH1 -> BCL2/BCL3 and apoptosis; canonical NICD-RBPJ branch not assigned to YBX1
decision_basis: Primary human THP-1 monocyte study reports that NOTCH1 knockdown or YBX1 overexpression reduces the benzene-induced apoptotic response and reverses the associated BCL3/BCL2 expression changes. This supports a bounded YBX1-NOTCH1 intracellular functional association, but not direct protein binding, TF occupancy, or a general SCI program.
